qualification_delta: The qualified SM89 Ref4 FFN merge/SiLU kernel is promoted through a direct method call; only this profile with strict backends, block size 1024 and scaling 0.0625 selects it. All 54 other package files and all pre-existing mathematical function definitions match the 0.2.1 complete-pipeline qualification source, which included the default-preserving FFN method seam. The promoted kernel and BF16 round helper have identical ASTs, and all 224 SM89 instructions / 448 machine words match offline in the pinned runtime. Public dispatch, temporary ownership, install, prepared-assets, arbitrary UID/cache and CLI checks pass on CPU. No new end-to-end speed ratio is claimed.

pipeline.name: hansimov/vflash:0.2.2-pipeline
pipeline.interface: five-second MP4: T2VA or Ref4 with one to three ordered images on one SM89 48 GB; Ref4 on two SM86 20 GB GPUs with sequence-head
pipeline.qualification: SM89 Ref4: same-instance original/fused/original three-reference complete requests; 14 conditioning tensors, final FP32 AV latents, 124 raw video frames and 120 delivery RGB frames exact; all video/audio decodes; NFE1 cancellation, partial-output removal and owned-storage release. Native-only fixed-workload median improvement 43.033 to 42.569 seconds (three warm repeats each), peak saving 597180416 bytes; no broad quality or bitwise audio guarantee. Existing SM86 and T2VA qualification is retained.

native.name: hansimov/vflash:0.2.2
native.interface: compiled conditioning bundles to video and audio latents, including native single and dual SM86 profiles
native.qualification: Same-SM89 Ref4 complete-trajectory exact AV outputs and three warm native repeats per implementation, plus installed CPU service and profile-dispatch checks. Other profiles preserve their prior operators. The published performance boundary excludes real-time encoding and media decoding.
